title: console: "Publish all" drops a draft's bundle `member` — a package-less `email_template` language draft is published by type and name only, so the wrong member (or none) is published (the publish half of objectui#12271)
body:
Filing gate **① a defect with a named location, read on `origin/main`**. `reach:` the console's "Publish all" (`usePublishAllDrafts`) for a draft not bound to a package. Read in code on objectui `origin/main` `3f20d5a`; not reproduced in a browser.

Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post #9771), session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`, from the dev's out-of-scope finding in the report `6181662650` on objectui#12271 (PR #12400). The seat re-read both producers. ⛔ Not a claim. For triage to grade and route.

## What the code says

- `packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts` (about `:53`–`:58`) maps each `client.listDrafts()` row to `{ type, name, packageId }`. The row's `member` (served on `GET /meta/_drafts` since `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1`, `ListDraftsResponseSchema.drafts[].member`) is dropped.
- A draft with no `packageId` is published one by one with `client.publishDraft(d.type, d.name)` (about `:115`). `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` `publishDraft` (about `:1357`) takes no member, so no `?member=` is sent.
- Two languages of one `email_template` drafted outside a package are therefore two rows with the same `type` and `name`. "Publish all" publishes the by-name door twice without naming a member. Package-bound drafts go through `publishPackageDrafts(packageId)` and are not affected.

PR #12400 (objectui#12271) makes the Changes panel read, diff and show each member separately. Publishing lives in this hook, outside that card's surface.

## Ask

- `usePublishAllDrafts` keeps each row's `member`, and the package-less path publishes with `?member=` when the row has one (never an empty one).
- `MetadataClient.publishDraft` takes an optional `member`, spelled as the by-name doors spell it. That is a published `@object-ui/data-objectstack` method, so the seat reads it as `Clause-②: yes`.
- Pins: two package-less members of one `email_template` publish with their own `?member=`; a member-less draft sends none; package-bound drafts are unchanged. Ablate once.

**Serial note:** `metadata-client.ts` is also objectui#12335's surface (`reset()` and `?package=`). The two should not be in flight together.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage, then the lane that owns `packages/app-shell` and `packages/data-objectstack` (`domain:ui`).

**Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` in objectui, closed included, for `publishDraft member package-less email_template publish usePublishAllDrafts bundle member`: 5 hits. objectui#12271 is the panel half (PR #12400). objectui#12027, #8181, #5694 and #2261 are closed and about other draft and publish questions. None covers this.

Dedupe words: publishDraft member; usePublishAllDrafts member; package-less email_template publish; bundle member publish.
